summary.title: Molly Rocket
summary.one_liner: The Molly Rocket site hosts Handmade Hero, a retired daily C game-programming series whose original source code archives can still be purchased, plus Casey's Computer Enhance courses.
takeaways: Handmade Hero is a retired daily programming series; its original source code archives can still be bought.
Casey's current programming courses are offered through computerenhance.com.
The site also lists Computer Enhance articles and courses on software performance.
Early purchasers can request a refund by emailing support from the address used for their order.
An episode guide and order recovery page are linked from the site.
summary.summary: This is the homepage of Molly Rocket, an independent studio, and it mostly serves as a hub for its products. The Handmade Hero section says the series has been retired, that its daily source code archives can still be purchased, and that lost download links can be recovered through SendOwl's order recovery page. It also points to an episode guide and to Casey's current courses at computerenhance.com. The rest of the page covers unrelated items: the Computer Enhance education resource, the Meow the Infinite graphic novel, and a secret game project for portfolio managers.
